patch_description:
This crossover combines the efficient vectorized moving-average baseline and strict input validation from the inspiration program with an improved causal adaptive constant-velocity Kalman trend estimator.

The enhanced filter uses robust first-difference MAD initialization, clipped innovations, adaptive measurement/process noise, and innovation-sign persistence to distinguish coherent trend changes from alternating noise. A lightweight output hysteresis stage suppresses only small counter-direction movements, reducing false reversals and slope changes without modifying the internal Kalman state or introducing an additional window delay. The public functions, arguments, return shapes, trailing-window alignment, and behavior of `process_signal` remain compatible with the original program.
